scope: V5 train and validation only; test export, test inference, and test-driven changes forbidden

scaler.source: unique observable context states from passive/train and action/train only

friday.load_policy: load all compatible GraphRSSM parameters; initialize missing action/branch parameters from the candidate seed

v4.load_policy: action track loads all compatible ActionGraphRSSM parameters; passive branch track loads only compatible GraphRSSM parameters and initializes branch parameters from the candidate seed

action_track.host_permutation_augmentation: uniform over all 120 five-host permutations; action pair and targets relabeled consistently
action_track.seed_selection: minimum deterministic validation (group-balanced future-state MSE + 0.25 future-edge BCE), ties within 1e-8 choose smaller seed
action_track.initialization_selection: same validation score; designate one primary initialization before test but retain one frozen checkpoint per initialization for prespecified diagnostic comparison
action_track.test_threshold_policy: fixed 0.5 is primary; validation-best F1 threshold may be frozen per candidate as a secondary diagnostic only

passive_branch_track.checkpoint_selection: minimum validation joint branch trajectory/gate plus weighted edge/semantic objective across all 250 epochs
passive_branch_track.seed_selection: minimum frozen validation selection score, ties within 1e-8 choose smaller seed
passive_branch_track.initialization_selection: same validation score; designate one primary initialization before test and retain one checkpoint per initialization
passive_branch_track.oracle_metric_policy: oracle branch state error measures candidate-future coverage only, never deployable inference accuracy
passive_branch_track.calibration_policy: Brier/ECE on small correlated validation/test windows are diagnostics, not deployment calibration evidence

primary_metrics: completed-LM average precision, Brier score, and F1 at fixed 0.5
completed-LM pair average precision and top-1
passive expected and oracle branch MAE with oracle labeled coverage-only
scenario and background-profile diagnostics with sample counts

claim_limits: one executed SSH service/hop and deterministic permit/block action
paired captures are similar but not packet-identical
no enterprise, unseen-topology, causal-policy, or deployment-calibration claim
